entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: The central seat of power of the Evincar of Rath, inside a volcano above the City of Traitors; the main Phyrexian military base and flowstone production center, later shifted to Urborg.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The artificial Phyrexian plane where the Stronghold stood.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where the Stronghold was shifted after the overlay.

entities.name: City of Traitors
entities.description: Grim city in the crater beneath the Stronghold.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Evincar of Rath who experimented on captured animals; his disappearance led to a succession dispute.

entities.name: Belbe
entities.description: Smashed the Dream Halls and attempted to sabotage the Stronghold's reactor.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Rebel leader who with Sivvi and Grizzlegom destroyed the Portcullis.

entities.name: Weatherlight crew
entities.description: The crew, including Karn, Tahngarth and Sisay, imprisoned in the Stronghold.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian who entered Dominaria through the planar portal in the Stronghold's throne room.

entities.name: Weaver King
entities.description: A once-human shadow creature who emerged from the Stronghold's ruins and toyed with Urborg's people.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: Leader whose Cabal took the Stronghold and raised it again with Bogardan lava mages.

entities.name: Stone dwarves
entities.description: Used magic to erupt the volcano and destroy the Stronghold.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The invasion for which the Stronghold served as base.

events.summary: As the Phyrexian Invasion nears completion, the Stronghold is the prison of Captain Sisay and later other Weatherlight crew; the crew loses Mirri, Ertai and Crovax.
events.quote: the Stronghold was the prison of Captain Sisay and later other members of the Weatherlight crew.

events.summary: Despite rebel incursions led by Eladamri and Liin Sivi, Volrath's disappearance and Belbe's sabotage attempt, the Stronghold stays in control of Rath until the overlay.
events.quote: the Stronghold remained firmly in control of Rath until its overlay with Dominaria.

events.summary: After the overlay the Stronghold sits in a dormant volcano in Urborg and becomes Phyrexian central command; a coalition besieges it.
events.quote: It took a combination of Yavimayan , Metathran , Keldon , Elven , and Talruum forces to successfully besiege the base.

events.summary: Stone dwarves erupt the dormant volcano, destroying the Stronghold, though its portal had already let Yawgmoth enter Dominaria.
events.quote: The Stronghold was ultimately destroyed by the stone dwarves

events.summary: The Weaver King emerges from the ruins of the Stronghold.
events.quote: from the ruins of the Stronghold emerged the Weaver King

events.summary: Sixty years after the Mending, Belzenlok's Cabal takes the Stronghold and raises it again with Bogardan lava mages.
events.quote: he was able to raise it again and reawaken the sleeping volcano

relations.note: Main Phyrexian base on Rath, later in Urborg.
relations.quote: as the main Phyrexian military base on Rath
When he was succeeded by Crovax
